name: Song Lyrics
description: Search LRCLIB (an open community lyrics database) and Genius for song lyrics, Christian music first, and import them into your song library as slides.

permissions.reason: Appears as a panel in the console

Searches LRCLIB and Genius, downloads the lyrics page for a Genius song you pick, and looks up each result's music genre in the iTunes store so non-Christian songs can be set aside (the server makes these requests, only to these hosts)
Adds the imported song to your song library
Adds the imported song to the schedule, and goes live for "Import & Go Live"
